away.summary: The Blue Jackets are on a four-game losing skid, all against Eastern Conference teams, and are coming off a 4-3 home loss to the Philadelphia Flyers. Head coach Rick Bowness will miss this game for medical testing, with assistant Don Granato expected to coach. Zach Werenski remains a key offensive contributor, ranking among NHL defensemen in assists and points.

out.detail: lower body injury, did not practice or skate in morning skate
lower body injury, will not play; next step is full contact practice

doubtful.detail: lower body injury, game-time decision; practiced with fourth line and skated in optional morning skate

home.summary: The Islanders are on a four-game point streak (2-0-2) after earning five of six points on a California road trip, including wins over the Kings and Ducks. Mathew Barzal made his season debut Saturday, while Simon Holmström recorded a hat trick and is tied with Bo Horvat for the team lead with nine goals. The team is hosting Columbus in a key Metropolitan Division matchup at UBS Arena.
